title: Resource summary citations RLS plan
description: Covers student-scoped RLS expectations for machine-resolved resource summary citations (NN-11).

cases.name: student can select own resource summary citations
student cannot select another student's resource summary citations
student cannot insert own resource summary citation
student cannot update own resource summary citation
student cannot delete own resource summary citation

ownership_notes: resource summary citations are system-written derived artifacts, not student input
each citation is a foreign key to public.chunks (student_id, chunk_id), never a free-text locator (NN-11, ENG-168)

each citation also references public.resources (student_id, resource_id); citation locality (chunk belongs to the same resource) is enforced at the AI Gateway citation-resolution layer and the summary-grounding eval gate, not by a database constraint
worker mutation relies on service-role bypass
no authenticated insert, update, or delete policy is expected
index_notes: resource_summary_id is indexed for per-summary citation retrieval
chunk_id is indexed for citation resolution lookups
